text.en:
The Auditor for the Philippine Islands is hereby authorized and directed to transfer on the books
of his office from appropriations heretofore made for public works and permanent improvements in the city
of Manila, to the general-revenue account as unappropriated moneys, the following balances undrawn and to
the credit of the city of Manila on account of said appropriations:
From the appropriation by Act Numbered Eight hundred and thirty, for schoolhouses, one hundred and
ninety-five thousand four hundred pesos; for tenement houses, thirty thousand pesos.
From the appropriation by Act Numbered One thousand and eighty-seven, for the construction of ornamental
shelter on the Luneta, six thousand four hundred pesos; for the construction of roadway and entrance to
Cemetery del Norte, six thousand six hundred and twenty pesos.
From the appropriation by Act Numbered Twelve hundred and twenty-two for ferry at Pandacan, four
thousand pesos; construction of fire-proof vaults, one thousand seven hundred and ninety pesos; Street
Bridge, twenty-four thousand pesos; two bridges on Calle Solis, eighteen thousand pesos; Moriones Bridge,
twenty-four thousand pesos; stone monuments for street intersections, two thousand pesos; and for
purchasing and placing street signs, two thousand seven hundred and fifty pesos.
In all, the sum of three hundred and fourteen thousand nine hundred and sixty pesos.

The following sum, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated, out of any
funds in the Treasury of the Philippine Islands not otherwise appropriated, for public works and permanent
improvements in the city of Manila, as follows:
For the general widening of streets throughout the city; and for the construction of temporary drains, diking,
bridging, and other incidental expenses in connection with the work of filling the moat about the Walled
City, one hundred and sixteen thousand six hundred pesos.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 9, 1905.
